name: AutoHedge
description: Build your autonomous hedge fund in minutes. AutoHedge harnesses the power of swarm intelligence and AI agents to automate market analysis, risk management, and trade execution.
readme_summary: AutoHedge is an enterprise-grade autonomous agent hedge fund that automates market analysis, risk management, and trade execution on platforms like Solana. It leverages swarm intelligence and specialized AI agents for end-to-end trading operations with minimal human intervention.
key_features: Multi-Agent Architecture (Director, Quant, Risk Management, Execution Agents)
primary_use_case: To build and operate an autonomous hedge fund that automates trading strategies.
cover_image_prompt: A sophisticated, anthropomorphic robot captain confidently steering a large, futuristic trading vessel through turbulent financial markets. The vessel's bridge displays holographic charts and data streams, representing real-time market analysis. Smaller drones, acting as specialized AI agents, buzz around the ship, performing tasks like risk assessment (a drone with a shield) and order execution (a drone launching a small, fast craft). The ship's wake is a trail of successful trade executions, visualized as glowing green lines. The AutoHedge logo is subtly integrated into the ship's hull. The overall mood is one of control and advanced automation in a dynamic financial ocean. 3D isometric illustration style with a clean, high-tech aesthetic and a color palette of deep blues, greens, and metallic accents.

name: ai-file-sorter
description: Cross-platform desktop application for content-aware file organization and renaming. Supports local and remote LLMs, preview-based workflows, and fully user-controlled changes.
readme_summary: AI File Sorter is a cross-platform desktop application designed to intelligently organize and rename files using AI. It supports both local and remote LLMs, offers a preview-based workflow for user control, and can process images, documents, audio, and video files.
key_features: Support for local and remote LLMs
Analysis of image content, document text, and media metadata
Privacy-first design with local processing option
primary_use_case: To automatically organize and rename files on a user's computer based on their content and metadata, reducing clutter and improving findability.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic filing cabinet with a glowing AI brain on top, actively sorting and renaming a chaotic pile of diverse files (images, documents, music notes) into neat, labeled folders. The cabinet is in a clean, organized digital workspace. Subtle glowing data streams flow from the files to the AI brain, and then back to the cabinet as organized outputs. Small, stylized UI elements showing file previews and rename suggestions are visible on the cabinet's drawers. The overall mood is helpful and efficient, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a bright, clean color palette, emphasizing clarity and ease of use for the AI File Sorter application.

name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
readme_summary: VoiceStudio is an open-source, local-first alternative to ElevenLabs, offering advanced voice cloning, design, and audio production tools. It supports a vast range of languages and TTS/ASR engines, running entirely on user hardware without subscriptions or API keys.
primary_use_case: To provide users with a powerful, private, and cost-effective solution for all their voice generation, cloning, and audio processing needs directly on their own hardware.
cover_image_prompt: A master craftsman in a high-tech workshop, surrounded by various sound wave sculptures and glowing vocal cords. The craftsman is carefully shaping a new voice from raw audio data flowing from a digital stream, while simultaneously directing a robotic arm to dub a scene in a video playing on a large screen. Subtle UI elements showing language selection and engine switching are visible on a nearby console. The scene is illuminated by the soft glow of digital particles and displays, conveying innovation and control. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, futuristic aesthetic, emphasizing the creation and manipulation of voice.

name: archify
description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
readme_summary: Archify is a Node.js system for generating interactive architecture diagrams from codebases or system descriptions. It supports multiple diagram types and presets, offers features for reviewing architectural changes, and produces self-contained HTML files with various export options.
key_features: Generates interactive system maps from codebases or descriptions
Supports five diagram types and four presets
Offers dark/light themes and built-in brand marks
Enables review of architecture changes with Before/Delta/After comparisons
Provides features for searching nodes, tracing reach, and comparing roles
Outputs self-contained HTML with PNG, SVG, WebM, and share card exports
Integrates with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode
primary_use_case: To automatically generate verifiable, interactive architecture and system diagrams from code or descriptions, facilitating code review and system understanding.
cover_image_prompt: A master cartographer meticulously drawing a complex, glowing city map on an ancient scroll. The city's buildings and infrastructure are represented by interconnected lines of code and data streams. Small, ethereal blueprints float around the cartographer, showing different architectural styles. In the background, a digital interface displays the 'Before' and 'After' states of the city map, highlighting changes. The overall mood is one of creation and clarity, with a subtle technological sheen. The style should be a blend of fantasy illustration and clean, modern digital art, emphasizing the transformation of raw code into a beautiful, understandable system.
